items.name: Forged Prison Record
items.description: A doctored record to reassign or release an inmate. Requires Lyd's cooperation.

items.name: Deputy's Ledger
items.description: Proof of Veit's entire smuggling operation. The key to taking him down.

items.name: Black Cells Roster
items.description: The official, off-the-books list of the 'disappeared'. The key to deposing the Warden.

items.name: Favor Chit
items.description: A carved token representing a debt. Can be used to bypass skill checks or gain access.

items.name: Shiv
items.description: Crafted from a spoon and a stone. A symbol of inmate defiance. (Increases Tension when used).

items.name: Crude Lockpick
items.description: A bent piece of wire. Might open a desk, might just break.

items.name: Contraband Stash
items.description: A hollowed-out book or loose brick. A safe place to store illegal items within the prison.

items.name: Soiled Guard Uniform
items.description: Stolen from the laundry. Not a perfect disguise, but it might get you past a quick glance.

items.name: Unsent Family Letter
items.description: A desperate plea or a final goodbye. A powerful tool for persuading guards like Bram. (Lowers Tension).
